'''Imperial Communique #617096.24k''' was an internal [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] message from [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Beri Tulon]] of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] to [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Brenn Tantor]] providing him an instruction due promotion and assignment to the [[Battlefield Holographic Control Interface|BHCI]] project.
